_about: Reference photos for the environment adversarial LOOK review (rounds 1-2, 2026-11-05). Reference only (never textures). 960-px thumbnails from Wikimedia Commons; licences as stated on each Commons file page (read 2026-11-05).

sfo_night_commons_960.jpg.use: clear night, aerial: floodlit aprons vs dark airfield, landside sodium lighting

sfo_dusk_lights_fog_2016_960.jpg.author: wbaiv (Bill Abbott), https://www.flickr.com/photos/9998127@N06/51953851754/
sfo_dusk_lights_fog_2016_960.jpg.taken: 2016-05-03 19:57:30 PDT (EXIF); Nikon D40X 55 mm 1/5 s f/4.5 ISO 1600 (EV100 2.66); Sun el 0.0 deg (js/env/ephemeris.js)
sfo_dusk_lights_fog_2016_960.jpg.use: OVERCAST / FOG dusk (not a clear-dusk colour reference): floodlight mast lamps, tower, fog bank over San Bruno Mountain
sfo_dusk_lights_fog_2016_960.jpg.caveat: Environment review round 2 (look2-13, M): EV100 2.66 at Sun 0.0 deg puts mid-grey at 12.5 x 2^2.66 / 100 = 0.79 cd/m2, ~2 orders of magnitude below a clear sunset sky (10^2-10^3 cd/m2, js/env/atmo/sky_model.js CPU mirror): the scene was under an overcast / fog deck (the title says fog) and its saturated blue may be white balance. Do not judge the clear-sky E3 dusk colour against it; a clear civil-twilight photo looking west at SFO is still missing (owner request, docs/research/environment_impl.md R2).
